title: ATHENA Evolt Stage-1 Structured Scan Input
description: Input format accepted by athena.importers.evolt.EvoltImporter for structured JSON. This is NOT the Evolt 360 PDF report format — PDF extraction (Stage 3) is not implemented. See athena/importers/evolt.py.

scan_id.description: Stable identifier for this scan session; defaults to the import batch id if omitted.

label.description: Evolt report field label, e.g. 'Skeletal Muscle Mass'. Matched case-insensitively against athena.importers.evolt.EVOLT_FIELD_LABEL_MAP; unrecognized labels are still imported but flagged as unmapped.
